blocks.text: The Development Services Director shall enforce, or cause to be enforced, all of the provisions of all ordinances governing the placing and installation of electrical wiring and appliances in the City. (Ord. 19072 § 8, 4-15-08. Code 1981 § 10-167. Code 1995 § 26-367.)
